name: AnCode — Estimated Delivery Date for WooCommerce
author: ancode

sections.description:
Woo Delivery Estimate by AnCode is a lightweight and customizable plugin that automatically displays the estimated delivery date on WooCommerce product pages and order emails.
Perfect for online stores that want to improve customer trust and transparency.

✨ Main Features
– Automatically calculate and display estimated delivery dates.
– Considers weekends and public holidays (via Nager API sync).
– Insert automatically on product pages — no template editing required.
– Compatible with caching systems (AJAX mode available).
– Fully customizable text, label, tooltip, and CSS.
– Include delivery estimates in WooCommerce customer emails.
– Multilingual ready — works with any language and locale.

💡 Ideal for eCommerce, dropshipping, and any WooCommerce store that wants to clearly communicate delivery expectations.

Description (Português)

O Woo Delivery Estimate by AnCode adiciona automaticamente a previsão de entrega às páginas de produto e aos emails do WooCommerce.
Ideal para lojas que desejam informar o prazo estimado de entrega de forma clara e profissional.

Principais funcionalidades
– Cálculo automático da data estimada de entrega.
– Considera fins de semana e feriados (sincronização automática via API Nager).
– Inserção automática sem editar o tema.
– Modo AJAX compatível com cache.
– Personalização completa de texto, rótulo e estilo.
– Inclusão opcional em emails de cliente.
– Totalmente gratuito e leve.

Shortcodes

[ancode_delivery_eta]

Attributes:
– days — Fixed number of working days (e.g., days="5")
– days_min / days_max — Delivery interval (e.g., days_min="2" days_max="4")
– country — Country code (e.g., country="PT")

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve public holiday data used for calculating estimated delivery dates.

Service used: Nager.Date Public Holidays API
Website: https://date.nager.at
Terms of Service: https://date.nager.at/Terms
Privacy Policy: https://date.nager.at/Privacy

What data is sent
The plugin sends:
– The selected country code (e.g. “PT”, “ES”)
– The selected year (e.g. 2025)

No personal user data, order information, email addresses, or IPs are sent.

When data is sent
The plugin requests holiday data:
– When the admin clicks the “Sync from API” button
– Automatically once per year (January 1st), if the admin keeps auto-sync enabled.

Why data is sent
The data is required to download the list of public holidays for the selected country/year and calculate delivery estimates accurately.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Go to AnCode → Woo Delivery Estimate in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Configure your country, default minimum and maximum days, and date format.
  4. (Optional) Customize text and enable automatic insertion on product pages.
